verdict.rationale: Gumroad is a commerce platform with a public REST API and an agent-facing OAuth+MCP integration, so a sandbox or test mode is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. Running the source-available repo locally is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
